page.layout: One printed title page, centred; an engraved emblem (eagle with wings and crowned head) below the imprint. Handwritten annotations in red ink and pencil at right and below are not printed and are omitted.

main_text.l: Italicè ita reddita & exposita, vt quiuis

page.notes: Printed title page with woodcut emblem. Handwritten annotations (red ink "Fr. Catrius junior, Burgranius, Sena", "ct 1 ꝯ xx") and pencil shelfmark "Su 4264" omitted as not printed. "DISTICHA" and "Ð" as printed; "Ð" is the printed letter for D. "Italicè" and "Lentulianæ" as printed.
